                    <span class="hidden sm:inline">Файлы проекта</span>

            </div>
        </div>

                        <span class="font-bold text-white">Управление базой</span>
                        <span class="text-[11px] font-mono text-cnn-orange">LIVE</span>

                    </p>
                    <button onclick="toggleAddContractForm()" class="w-full py-2.5 px-3 rounded-lg bg-cnn-orange hover:bg-cnn-orangeHover text-white font-bold text-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-orange-sm">
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="plus-circle" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-plus-circle w-4 h-4"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><path d="M8 12h8"></path><path d="M12 8v8"></path></svg>

            <!-- ========================================================= -->
            <section id="testSuiteSection" class="hidden bg-cnn-card border-2 border-cnn-orange/70 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-orange-glow">
                <div class="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 mb-4 border-b border-cnn-border">
                    <div class="flex items-start gap-3">
                        <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-cnn-orange flex items-center justify-center text-white shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="flask-conical" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-flask-conical w-5 h-5"><path d="M14 2v6a2 2 0 0 0 .245.96l5.51 10.08A2 2 0 0 1 18 22H6a2 2 0 0 1-1.755-2.96l5.51-10.08A2 2 0 0 0 10 8V2"></path><path d="M6.453 15h11.094"></path><path d="M8.5 2h7"></path></svg>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <h2 class="text-base sm:text-lg font-extrabold text-white">Лаборатория тестирования сроков и авто-удаления контрактов</h2>
                                <span id="timeOffsetBadge" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-cnn-surface text-cnn-orange font-mono text-xs font-bold">
                                    Смещение: +0 дн.
                                </span>
                            </div>
                            <p class="text-xs text-cnn-textMuted mt-0.5">
                                Проверьте точное отображение часов без округления, статус «Скоро истекает» (&lt; 2 дней) и авто-удаление при окончании времени.
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <button onclick="toggleTestPanel()" class="self-end lg:self-center text-xs text-cnn-textMuted hover:text-white px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cnn-surface">
                        Скрыть панель тестов
                    </button>
                </div>

                <!-- Test Action Buttons -->
                <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-5 gap-2.5 mb-4">
                    <button onclick="runAutomatedContractTests()" class="py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-cnn-orange hover:bg-cnn-orangeHover text-white font-bold text-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-orange-sm">
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="play" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-play w-4 h-4"><path d="M5 5a2 2 0 0 1 3.008-1.728l11.997 6.998a2 2 0 0 1 .003 3.458l-12 7A2 2 0 0 1 5 19z"></path></svg>
                        <span>Запустить авто-тесты (4 шт.)</span>
                    </button>

                    <button onclick="spawnFiveSecondTestContract()" class="py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-cnn-surface hover:bg-cnn-border text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 font-semibold text-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="timer" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-timer w-4 h-4"><line x1="10" x2="14" y1="2" y2="2"></line><line x1="12" x2="15" y1="14" y2="11"></line><circle cx="12" cy="14" r="8"></circle></svg>
                        <span>+ Контракт на 5 сек (Live-тест)</span>
                    </button>

                    <button onclick="spawnExpiringSoonTestContract()" class="py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-cnn-surface hover:bg-cnn-border text-gray-200 border border-cnn-border font-semibold text-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="alert-triangle" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-alert-triangle w-4 h-4 text-amber-400"><path d="m21.73 18-8-14a2 2 0 0 0-3.48 0l-8 14A2 2 0 0 0 4 21h16a2 2 0 0 0 1.73-3"></path><path d="M12 9v4"></path><path d="M12 17h.01"></path></svg>
                        <span>+ Контракт 18 ч. (Скоро истекает)</span>
                    </button>

                    <button onclick="advanceSimulatedTimeDays(1)" class="py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-cnn-surface hover:bg-cnn-border text-gray-200 border border-cnn-border font-semibold text-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="fast-forward" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-fast-forward w-4 h-4 text-cnn-orange"><path d="M12 6a2 2 0 0 1 3.414-1.414l6 6a2 2 0 0 1 0 2.828l-6 6A2 2 0 0 1 12 18z"></path><path d="M2 6a2 2 0 0 1 3.414-1.414l6 6a2 2 0 0 1 0 2.828l-6 6A2 2 0 0 1 2 18z"></path></svg>
                        <span>Перемотать время +1 день</span>
                    </button>

                    <button onclick="resetTestEnvironment()" class="py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-cnn-bg hover:bg-cnn-surface text-cnn-textMuted hover:text-white border border-cnn-border font-semibold text-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="rotate-ccw" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-rotate-ccw w-4 h-4"><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 1 0 9-9 9.75 9.75 0 0 0-6.74 2.74L3 8"></path><path d="M3 3v5h5"></path></svg>
                        <span>Сбросить базу и время</span>
                    </button>
                </div>

                <!-- Test Console Output -->
                <div class="bg-cnn-bg border border-cnn-border rounded-xl p-3">
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono text-cnn-textMuted mb-1.5">
                        <span>ЖУРНАЛ ТЕСТИРОВАНИЯ И АВТО-УДАЛЕНИЯ (tests.js):</span>
                        <button onclick="clearTestLog()" class="hover:text-white">Очистить лог</button>
                    </div>
                    <div id="testConsoleLog" class="font-mono text-xs space-y-1 max-h-36 overflow-y-auto text-gray-300">
                        <div class="text-cnn-textMuted">[Система готова] Нажмите «Запустить авто-тесты» или «+ Контракт на 5 сек», чтобы проверить авто-удаление.</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </section>

            <!-- ========================================== -->
            <!-- CONTRACTS LIST & ADD CONTRACT SECTION      -->
            <!-- ========================================== -->
            <section id="viewContracts" class="space-y-5 hidden">
                
                <!-- Top Header Banner -->
                <div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-5 border-b border-cnn-border">
                    <div class="max-w-2xl">
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                            <h1 class="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white">
                                Список активных контрактов
                            </h1>
                            <span class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-bold bg-cnn-orangeMuted text-cnn-orange border border-cnn-orange/30">
                                LIVE
                            </span>
                        </div>
                        <p class="text-sm text-cnn-textMuted mt-1">
                            Нажмите на <span class="text-cnn-orange font-semibold">кодовое слово</span> для мгновенного копирования текста или нажмите на компактный спойлер <span class="text-gray-200 font-semibold">«текст»</span> правее него.
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2.5 md:ml-auto shrink-0">
                        <button id="toggleAddContractBtn" onclick="toggleAddContractForm()" class="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-cnn-orange hover:bg-cnn-orangeHover text-white text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-2 shadow-orange-sm">
                            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="file-plus-2" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-file-plus-2 w-4 h-4"><path d="M11.35 22H6a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h8a2.4 2.4 0 0 1 1.706.706l3.588 3.588A2.4 2.4 0 0 1 20 8v5.35"></path><path d="M14 2v5a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h5"></path><path d="M14 19h6"></path><path d="M17 16v6"></path></svg>
                            <span>+ Добавить контракт</span>
                        </button>

                <!-- ADD NEW CONTRACT FORM (Directly on the Main Page) -->
                <div id="addContractSection" class="hidden bg-cnn-card border-2 border-cnn-orange/60 rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-orange-sm">
                    <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pb-4 mb-4 border-b border-cnn-border">
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                            <div class="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-cnn-orangeMuted border border-cnn-orange/40 flex items-center justify-center text-cnn-orange">
                                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="file-plus-2" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-file-plus-2 w-5 h-5"><path d="M11.35 22H6a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h8a2.4 2.4 0 0 1 1.706.706l3.588 3.588A2.4 2.4 0 0 1 20 8v5.35"></path><path d="M14 2v5a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h5"></path><path d="M14 19h6"></path><path d="M17 16v6"></path></svg>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                                <h2 class="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-white">Добавление нового контракта</h2>
                                <p class="text-xs text-cnn-textMuted">Выставьте до какого числа и часа активен контракт (или укажите срок в днях и часах)</p>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <button type="button" onclick="fillSampleContract()" class="text-xs text-cnn-orange hover:underline font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
                                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="wand-2" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-wand-2 w-3.5 h-3.5"><path d="m21.64 3.64-1.28-1.28a1.21 1.21 0 0 0-1.72 0L2.36 18.64a1.21 1.21 0 0 0 0 1.72l1.28 1.28a1.2 1.2 0 0 0 1.72 0L21.64 5.36a1.2 1.2 0 0 0 0-1.72"></path><path d="m14 7 3 3"></path><path d="M5 6v4"></path><path d="M19 14v4"></path><path d="M10 2v2"></path><path d="M7 8H3"></path><path d="M21 16h-4"></path><path d="M11 3H9"></path></svg>
                                <span>Заполнить пример</span>
                            </button>
                            <button type="button" onclick="toggleAddContractForm()" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cnn-surface hover:bg-cnn-border text-xs text-cnn-textMuted hover:text-white">
                                Скрыть
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <form id="addContractForm" onsubmit="handleCreateContract(event)" class="space-y-4">
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                            <!-- Codeword -->
                            <div>
                                <label class="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-300 mb-1.5">
                                    Кодовое слово <span class="text-cnn-orange">*</span>
                                </label>
                                <input id="contractCodewordInput" type="text" required="" placeholder="Напр.: ОЛИМП-24" class="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-cnn-bg border border-cnn-border focus:border-cnn-orange focus:outline-none text-sm text-cnn-orange font-mono font-bold uppercase">
                            </div>

                            <!-- Contractor Name -->
                            <div>
                                <label class="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-300 mb-1.5">
                                    С кем контракт <span class="text-cnn-orange">*</span>
                                </label>
                                <input id="contractPartnerInput" type="text" required="" placeholder="Напр.: Burger Shot" class="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-cnn-bg border border-cnn-border focus:border-cnn-orange focus:outline-none text-sm text-white">
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Expiration Date/Time & Days/Hours Synced Block -->
                        <div class="p-4 rounded-xl bg-cnn-bg/80 border border-cnn-border space-y-3.5">
                            <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                                <div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider">
                                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="calendar-clock" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-calendar-clock w-4 h-4 text-cnn-orange"><path d="M16 14v2.2l1.6 1"></path><path d="M16 2v3"></path><path d="M21 7.338V5a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v14a2 2 0 002 2h2.338"></path><path d="M3 9h5.859"></path><path d="M8 2v3"></path><circle cx="16" cy="16" r="6"></circle></svg>
                                    <span>Настройка срока: до какого числа активен (в днях и часах)</span>
                                </div>
                                <div id="contractExpirationPreviewBadge" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cnn-orangeMuted border border-cnn-orange/30 text-xs font-mono text-cnn-orange font-semibold">Активен до 13.10.2026 06:40 (7 дн. 0 ч.) • Счетчик: 7 дн.</div>
                            </div>

                            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3.5">
                                <!-- Target Date ("До какого числа") -->
                                <div>
                                    <label class="block text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-300 mb-1">
                                        Активен до числа <span class="text-cnn-orange">*</span>
                                    </label>
                                    <input id="contractTargetDateInput" type="date" required="" onchange="syncDurationFromTargetDate()" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-cnn-card border border-cnn-border focus:border-cnn-orange focus:outline-none text-sm text-white font-mono">
                                </div>

                                <!-- Target Hour ("Время / Час окончания") -->
                                <div>
                                    <label class="block text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-300 mb-1">
                                        Время окончания (ч:мин)
                                    </label>
                                    <input id="contractTargetTimeInput" type="time" required="" onchange="syncDurationFromTargetDate()" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-cnn-card border border-cnn-border focus:border-cnn-orange focus:outline-none text-sm text-white font-mono">
                                </div>

                                <!-- Days -->
                                <div>
                                    <label class="block text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-300 mb-1">
                                        В днях <span class="text-cnn-orange">*</span>
                                    </label>
                                    <div class="relative">
                                        <input id="contractDaysInput" type="number" step="1" min="0" value="7" required="" oninput="syncTargetDateFromDuration()" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-cnn-card border border-cnn-border focus:border-cnn-orange focus:outline-none text-sm text-white font-mono font-bold pr-12">
                                        <span class="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-xs font-mono text-cnn-textMuted">дн.</span>
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                <!-- Exact Hours (0-23) -->
                                <div>
                                    <label class="block text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-300 mb-1">
                                        И часах (0–23)
                                    </label>
                                    <div class="relative">
                                        <input id="contractHoursInput" type="number" step="1" min="0" max="23" value="0" required="" oninput="syncTargetDateFromDuration()" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-cnn-card border border-cnn-border focus:border-cnn-orange focus:outline-none text-sm text-white font-mono font-bold pr-10">
                                        <span class="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-xs font-mono text-cnn-textMuted">ч.</span>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <!-- Quick Preset Days/Hours Pills -->
                            <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs pt-1">
                                <span class="text-cnn-textMuted">Быстрый выбор срока:</span>
                                <button type="button" onclick="setContractTimePreset(30, 0)" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cnn-card hover:bg-cnn-surface border border-cnn-border text-gray-300 font-mono">+30 дн.</button>
                                <button type="button" onclick="setContractTimePreset(14, 0)" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cnn-card hover:bg-cnn-surface border border-cnn-border text-gray-300 font-mono">+14 дн.</button>
                                <button type="button" onclick="setContractTimePreset(7, 0)" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cnn-card hover:bg-cnn-surface border border-cnn-border text-gray-300 font-mono">+7 дн.</button>
                                <button type="button" onclick="setContractTimePreset(3, 12)" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cnn-card hover:bg-cnn-surface border border-cnn-border text-gray-300 font-mono">+3 дн. 12 ч.</button>
                                <button type="button" onclick="setContractTimePreset(1, 0)" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cnn-card hover:bg-cnn-surface border border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300 font-mono">+1 дн. (Скоро истекает)</button>
                                <button type="button" onclick="setContractTimePreset(0, 18)" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cnn-card hover:bg-cnn-surface border border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300 font-mono">+18 ч.</button>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Full Contract Text -->
                        <div>
                            <label class="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-300 mb-1.5">
                                Полный текст контракта (скрыт под спойлером и копируется по клику на кодовое слово) <span class="text-cnn-orange">*</span>
                            </label>
                            <textarea id="contractFullTextInput" rows="3" required="" placeholder="Введите полный рекламный текст контракта..." class="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-cnn-bg border border-cnn-border focus:border-cnn-orange focus:outline-none text-sm text-white leading-relaxed"></textarea>
                        </div>

                        <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-1">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-cnn-textMuted">
                                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="clock" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-clock w-4 h-4 text-cnn-orange shrink-0"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><path d="M12 6v6l4 2"></path></svg>
                                <span>Вы можете выбрать <b>дату в календаре</b> или <b>дни и часы</b> — счетчик сам посчитает дни до окончания.</span>
                            </div>

                            <button type="submit" class="py-2.5 px-6 rounded-xl bg-cnn-orange hover:bg-cnn-orangeHover text-white font-bold text-sm transition-all shadow-orange-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                                <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="plus-circle" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-plus-circle w-4 h-4"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><path d="M8 12h8"></path><path d="M12 8v8"></path></svg>
                                <span>Добавить в список</span>
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </form>
                </div>

                <!-- Search & Status Filter Bar + Right-aligned Legend -->
                <div class="flex flex-col xl:flex-row items-stretch xl:items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-cnn-card p-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-cnn-border">
                    <div class="relative flex-1">
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="search" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-search w-4 h-4 text-cnn-textMuted absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2"><path d="m21 21-4.34-4.34"></path><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle></svg>
                        <input id="contractSearchInput" type="text" oninput="renderContracts()" placeholder="Поиск по кодовому слову, контрагенту или тексту..." class="w-full pl-10 pr-9 py-2 rounded-xl bg-cnn-bg border border-cnn-border focus:border-cnn-orange focus:outline-none text-sm text-white placeholder:text-cnn-textMuted transition-colors">
                        <button id="clearSearchBtn" onclick="clearContractSearch()" class="hidden absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-cnn-textMuted hover:text-white">
                            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="x" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-x w-4 h-4"><path d="M18 6 6 18"></path><path d="m6 6 12 12"></path></svg>
                        </button>
                    </div>

                    <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between xl:justify-end gap-2.5 shrink-0">
                        <!-- Filter by Expiration Status ("Активен" / "Скоро истекает") -->
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-cnn-bg p-1 rounded-xl border border-cnn-border">
                            <button onclick="setContractFilter('all')" id="filterBtnAll" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all bg-cnn-orange text-white">
                                Все контракты
                            </button>
                            <button onclick="setContractFilter('active')" id="filterBtnActive" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all text-cnn-textMuted hover:text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400"></span>
                                <span>Активен (≥ 2 дн.)</span>
                            </button>
                            <button onclick="setContractFilter('expiring')" id="filterBtnExpiring" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all text-cnn-textMuted hover:text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400"></span>
                                <span>Скоро истекает (&lt; 2 дн.)</span>
                            </button>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Right-side Auto-delete Rule Badge -->
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-cnn-bg border border-cnn-border text-[11px] text-cnn-textMuted ml-auto xl:ml-0">
                            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="trash-2" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-trash-2 w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cnn-orange shrink-0"><path d="M10 11v6"></path><path d="M14 11v6"></path><path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6"></path><path d="M3 6h18"></path><path d="M8 6V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"></path></svg>
                            <span>При <b class="text-white font-mono">0 ч.</b> контракт удаляется автоматически</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Contracts Vertical List Header Labels (Desktop) -->
                <div class="hidden md:flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-2 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-cnn-textMuted">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
                        <span>Статус / Осталось времени / Кодовое слово</span>
                        <span class="text-cnn-orange">•</span>
                        <span>Спойлер (текст)</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="text-right">С кем заключен контракт</div>
                </div>

                <!-- Contracts Vertical List Container -->
                <div id="contractsListContainer" class="flex flex-col space-y-3">
                    <div class="contract-row bg-cnn-card border border-cnn-orange/50 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden">
                        <div class="p-3.5 sm:px-5 flex flex-wrap sm:flex-nowrap items-center justify-between gap-3 w-full">
                            
                            <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold bg-cnn-orangeMuted text-cnn-orange border border-cnn-orange/40" title="Закрепленный контракт">
                         <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="pin" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-pin w-3 h-3"><path d="M12 17v5"></path><path d="M9 10.76a2 2 0 0 1-1.11 1.79l-1.78.9A2 2 0 0 0 5 15.24V16a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h12a1 1 0 0 0 1-1v-.76a2 2 0 0 0-1.11-1.79l-1.78-.9A2 2 0 0 1 15 10.76V7a1 1 0 0 1 1-1 2 2 0 0 0 0-4H8a2 2 0 0 0 0 4 1 1 0 0 1 1 1z"></path></svg>
                       </span>
                                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30 shrink-0" title="Контракт активен (осталось 2 и более дней)">
                         <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400"></span>
                         <span>Активен</span>
                       </span>
                                
                    <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-semibold bg-cnn-bg border border-cnn-border text-gray-200 shrink-0" title="Точный остаток: 10 дн. 0 ч. • Активен до 16.10.2026 06:40">
                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="clock" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-clock w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cnn-orange"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><path d="M12 6v6l4 2"></path></svg>
                        <span class="font-bold">10 дн.</span>
                        <span class="text-[10px] text-cnn-textMuted border-l border-cnn-border pl-1.5 hidden sm:inline">до 16.10 06:40</span>
                    </span>
                

                                <div class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                    <button type="button" onclick="copyContractById('c-201', 'codeword')" title="Нажмите на кодовое слово, чтобы скопировать полный текст контракта" class="codeword-btn group inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-cnn-orange hover:bg-cnn-orangeHover text-white font-mono font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-orange-sm transition-all cursor-pointer">
                                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="hash" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-hash w-3.5 h-3.5 opacity-85"><line x1="4" x2="20" y1="9" y2="9"></line><line x1="4" x2="20" y1="15" y2="15"></line><line x1="10" x2="8" y1="3" y2="21"></line><line x1="16" x2="14" y1="3" y2="21"></line></svg>
                                        <span>БУРГЕР</span>
                                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="copy" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-copy w-3 h-3 opacity-80 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg>
                                    </button>

                                    <button type="button" onclick="toggleContractSpoiler('c-201')" aria-expanded="false" title="Открыть / скрыть полный текст контракта" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cnn-surface hover:bg-cnn-border text-cnn-textMuted hover:text-white border-cnn-border text-[11px] leading-none font-medium transition-all border shrink-0">
                                        <span>текст</span>
                                        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="chevron-down" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down w-3 h-3 transition-transform duration-200"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 ml-auto text-right shrink-0">
                                <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="building-2" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-building-2 w-4 h-4 text-cnn-orange shrink-0"><path d="M10 12h4"></path><path d="M10 8h4"></path><path d="M14 21v-3a2 2 0 0 0-4 0v3"></path><path d="M6 10H4a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v7a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h16a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V9a2 2 0 0 0-2-2h-2"></path><path d="M6 21V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h8a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v16"></path></svg>
                                    <span class="text-sm font-bold text-white whitespace-nowrap">Сеть ресторанов «Burger Shot»</span>
                                </div>

                                <button type="button" onclick="togglePinContract('c-201')" title="Открепить контракт" class="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-cnn-orange text-white border border-cnn-border transition-colors shrink-0">
                                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="pin" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-pin w-3.5 h-3.5"><path d="M12 17v5"></path><path d="M9 10.76a2 2 0 0 1-1.11 1.79l-1.78.9A2 2 0 0 0 5 15.24V16a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h12a1 1 0 0 0 1-1v-.76a2 2 0 0 0-1.11-1.79l-1.78-.9A2 2 0 0 1 15 10.76V7a1 1 0 0 1 1-1 2 2 0 0 0 0-4H8a2 2 0 0 0 0 4 1 1 0 0 1 1 1z"></path></svg>
                                </button>

                                <button type="button" onclick="copyContractById('c-201', 'button')" title="Скопировать полный текст" class="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-cnn-bg hover:bg-cnn-surface text-cnn-textMuted hover:text-cnn-orange border border-cnn-border transition-colors shrink-0">
                                    <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="clipboard-copy" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-clipboard-copy w-3.5 h-3.5"><rect width="8" height="4" x="8" y="2" rx="1" ry="1"></rect><path d="M8 4H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-2"></path><path d="M16 4h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v4"></path><path d="M21 14H11"></path><path d="m15 10-4 4 4 4"></path></svg>
                                </button>

            &lt;section id="viewContracts" class="space-y-5 hidden"&gt;
                
                &lt;!-- Top Header Banner --&gt;
                &lt;div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-5 border-b border-cnn-border"&gt;
                    &lt;div class="max-w-2xl"&gt;
                        &lt;div class="flex items-center gap-2.5"&gt;
                            &lt;h1 class="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white"&gt;
                                Список активных контрактов
                            &lt;/h1&gt;
                            &lt;span class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-bold bg-cnn-orangeMuted text-cnn-orange border border-cnn-orange/30"&gt;
                                LIVE
                            &lt;/span&gt;
                        &lt;/div&gt;
                        &lt;p class="text-sm text-cnn-textMuted mt-1"&gt;
                            Нажмите на &lt;span class="text-cnn-orange font-semibold"&gt;кодовое слово&lt;/span&gt; для мгновенного копирования текста или нажмите на компактный спойлер &lt;span class="text-gray-200 font-semibold"&gt;«текст»&lt;/span&gt; правее него.
                        &lt;/p&gt;
                    &lt;/div&gt;

                    &lt;div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2.5 md:ml-auto shrink-0"&gt;
                        &lt;button id="toggleAddContractBtn" onclick="toggleAddContractForm()" class="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-cnn-orange hover:bg-cnn-orangeHover text-white text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-2 shadow-orange-sm"&gt;
                            &lt;svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="file-plus-2" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-file-plus-2 w-4 h-4"&gt;&lt;path d="M11.35 22H6a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h8a2.4 2.4 0 0 1 1.706.706l3.588 3.588A2.4 2.4 0 0 1 20 8v5.35"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M14 2v5a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h5"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M14 19h6"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M17 16v6"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;
                            &lt;span&gt;+ Добавить контракт&lt;/span&gt;
                        &lt;/button&gt;
                    &lt;/div&gt;
                &lt;/div&gt;

                &lt;!-- ADD NEW CONTRACT FORM (Directly on the Main Page) --&gt;
                &lt;div id="addContractSection" class="hidden bg-cnn-card border-2 border-cnn-orange/60 rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-orange-sm"&gt;
                    &lt;div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pb-4 mb-4 border-b border-cnn-border"&gt;
                        &lt;div class="flex items-center gap-2.5"&gt;
                            &lt;div class="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-cnn-orangeMuted border border-cnn-orange/40 flex items-center justify-center text-cnn-orange"&gt;
                                &lt;svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="file-plus-2" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-file-plus-2 w-5 h-5"&gt;&lt;path d="M11.35 22H6a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h8a2.4 2.4 0 0 1 1.706.706l3.588 3.588A2.4 2.4 0 0 1 20 8v5.35"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M14 2v5a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h5"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M14 19h6"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M17 16v6"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;
                            &lt;/div&gt;
                            &lt;div&gt;
                                &lt;h2 class="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-white"&gt;Добавление нового контракта&lt;/h2&gt;
                                &lt;p class="text-xs text-cnn-textMuted"&gt;Выставьте до какого числа и часа активен контракт (или укажите срок в днях и часах)&lt;/p&gt;
                            &lt;/div&gt;
                        &lt;/div&gt;

                        &lt;div class="flex items-center gap-3"&gt;
                            &lt;button type="button" onclick="fillSampleContract()" class="text-xs text-cnn-orange hover:underline font-semibold flex items-center gap-1"&gt;
                                &lt;svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="wand-2" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-wand-2 w-3.5 h-3.5"&gt;&lt;path d="m21.64 3.64-1.28-1.28a1.21 1.21 0 0 0-1.72 0L2.36 18.64a1.21 1.21 0 0 0 0 1.72l1.28 1.28a1.2 1.2 0 0 0 1.72 0L21.64 5.36a1.2 1.2 0 0 0 0-1.72"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="m14 7 3 3"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M5 6v4"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M19 14v4"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M10 2v2"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M7 8H3"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M21 16h-4"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M11 3H9"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;
                                &lt;span&gt;Заполнить пример&lt;/span&gt;
                            &lt;/button&gt;
                            &lt;button type="button" onclick="toggleAddContractForm()" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cnn-surface hover:bg-cnn-border text-xs text-cnn-textMuted hover:text-white"&gt;
                                Скрыть
                            &lt;/button&gt;
                        &lt;/div&gt;
                    &lt;/div&gt;

                    &lt;form id="addContractForm" onsubmit="handleCreateContract(event)" class="space-y-4"&gt;
                        &lt;div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4"&gt;
                            &lt;!-- Codeword --&gt;
                            &lt;div&gt;
                                &lt;label class="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-300 mb-1.5"&gt;
                                    Кодовое слово &lt;span class="text-cnn-orange"&gt;*&lt;/span&gt;
                                &lt;/label&gt;
                                &lt;input id="contractCodewordInput" type="text" required="" placeholder="Напр.: ОЛИМП-24" class="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-cnn-bg border border-cnn-border focus:border-cnn-orange focus:outline-none text-sm text-cnn-orange font-mono font-bold uppercase"&gt;
                            &lt;/div&gt;

                            &lt;!-- Contractor Name --&gt;
                            &lt;div&gt;
                                &lt;label class="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-300 mb-1.5"&gt;
                                    С кем контракт &lt;span class="text-cnn-orange"&gt;*&lt;/span&gt;
                                &lt;/label&gt;
                                &lt;input id="contractPartnerInput" type="text" required="" placeholder="Напр.: Burger Shot" class="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-cnn-bg border border-cnn-border focus:border-cnn-orange focus:outline-none text-sm text-white"&gt;
                            &lt;/div&gt;
                        &lt;/div&gt;

                        &lt;!-- Expiration Date/Time &amp; Days/Hours Synced Block --&gt;
                        &lt;div class="p-4 rounded-xl bg-cnn-bg/80 border border-cnn-border space-y-3.5"&gt;
                            &lt;div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2"&gt;
                                &lt;div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider"&gt;
                                    &lt;svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="calendar-clock" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-calendar-clock w-4 h-4 text-cnn-orange"&gt;&lt;path d="M16 14v2.2l1.6 1"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M16 2v3"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M21 7.338V5a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v14a2 2 0 002 2h2.338"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M3 9h5.859"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M8 2v3"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;circle cx="16" cy="16" r="6"&gt;&lt;/circle&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;
                                    &lt;span&gt;Настройка срока: до какого числа активен (в днях и часах)&lt;/span&gt;
                                &lt;/div&gt;
                                &lt;div id="contractExpirationPreviewBadge" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cnn-orangeMuted border border-cnn-orange/30 text-xs font-mono text-cnn-orange font-semibold"&gt;Активен до 13.10.2026 06:40 (7 дн. 0 ч.) • Счетчик: 7 дн.&lt;/div&gt;
                            &lt;/div&gt;

                            &lt;div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3.5"&gt;
                                &lt;!-- Target Date ("До какого числа") --&gt;
                                &lt;div&gt;
                                    &lt;label class="block text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-300 mb-1"&gt;
                                        Активен до числа &lt;span class="text-cnn-orange"&gt;*&lt;/span&gt;
                                    &lt;/label&gt;
                                    &lt;input id="contractTargetDateInput" type="date" required="" onchange="syncDurationFromTargetDate()" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-cnn-card border border-cnn-border focus:border-cnn-orange focus:outline-none text-sm text-white font-mono"&gt;
                                &lt;/div&gt;

                                &lt;!-- Target Hour ("Время / Час окончания") --&gt;
                                &lt;div&gt;
                                    &lt;label class="block text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-300 mb-1"&gt;
                                        Время окончания (ч:мин)
                                    &lt;/label&gt;
                                    &lt;input id="contractTargetTimeInput" type="time" required="" onchange="syncDurationFromTargetDate()" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-cnn-card border border-cnn-border focus:border-cnn-orange focus:outline-none text-sm text-white font-mono"&gt;
                                &lt;/div&gt;

                                &lt;!-- Days --&gt;
                                &lt;div&gt;
                                    &lt;label class="block text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-300 mb-1"&gt;
                                        В днях &lt;span class="text-cnn-orange"&gt;*&lt;/span&gt;
                                    &lt;/label&gt;
                                    &lt;div class="relative"&gt;
                                        &lt;input id="contractDaysInput" type="number" step="1" min="0" value="7" required="" oninput="syncTargetDateFromDuration()" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-cnn-card border border-cnn-border focus:border-cnn-orange focus:outline-none text-sm text-white font-mono font-bold pr-12"&gt;
                                        &lt;span class="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-xs font-mono text-cnn-textMuted"&gt;дн.&lt;/span&gt;
                                    &lt;/div&gt;
                                &lt;/div&gt;

                                &lt;!-- Exact Hours (0-23) --&gt;
                                &lt;div&gt;
                                    &lt;label class="block text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-300 mb-1"&gt;
                                        И часах (0–23)
                                    &lt;/label&gt;
                                    &lt;div class="relative"&gt;
                                        &lt;input id="contractHoursInput" type="number" step="1" min="0" max="23" value="0" required="" oninput="syncTargetDateFromDuration()" class="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-cnn-card border border-cnn-border focus:border-cnn-orange focus:outline-none text-sm text-white font-mono font-bold pr-10"&gt;
                                        &lt;span class="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-xs font-mono text-cnn-textMuted"&gt;ч.&lt;/span&gt;
                                    &lt;/div&gt;
                                &lt;/div&gt;
                            &lt;/div&gt;

                            &lt;!-- Quick Preset Days/Hours Pills --&gt;
                            &lt;div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs pt-1"&gt;
                                &lt;span class="text-cnn-textMuted"&gt;Быстрый выбор срока:&lt;/span&gt;
                                &lt;button type="button" onclick="setContractTimePreset(30, 0)" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cnn-card hover:bg-cnn-surface border border-cnn-border text-gray-300 font-mono"&gt;+30 дн.&lt;/button&gt;
                                &lt;button type="button" onclick="setContractTimePreset(14, 0)" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cnn-card hover:bg-cnn-surface border border-cnn-border text-gray-300 font-mono"&gt;+14 дн.&lt;/button&gt;
                                &lt;button type="button" onclick="setContractTimePreset(7, 0)" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cnn-card hover:bg-cnn-surface border border-cnn-border text-gray-300 font-mono"&gt;+7 дн.&lt;/button&gt;
                                &lt;button type="button" onclick="setContractTimePreset(3, 12)" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cnn-card hover:bg-cnn-surface border border-cnn-border text-gray-300 font-mono"&gt;+3 дн. 12 ч.&lt;/button&gt;
                                &lt;button type="button" onclick="setContractTimePreset(1, 0)" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cnn-card hover:bg-cnn-surface border border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300 font-mono"&gt;+1 дн. (Скоро истекает)&lt;/button&gt;
                                &lt;button type="button" onclick="setContractTimePreset(0, 18)" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cnn-card hover:bg-cnn-surface border border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300 font-mono"&gt;+18 ч.&lt;/button&gt;
                            &lt;/div&gt;
                        &lt;/div&gt;

                        &lt;!-- Full Contract Text --&gt;
                        &lt;div&gt;
                            &lt;label class="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-300 mb-1.5"&gt;
                                Полный текст контракта (скрыт под спойлером и копируется по клику на кодовое слово) &lt;span class="text-cnn-orange"&gt;*&lt;/span&gt;
                            &lt;/label&gt;
                            &lt;textarea id="contractFullTextInput" rows="3" required="" placeholder="Введите полный рекламный текст контракта..." class="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-cnn-bg border border-cnn-border focus:border-cnn-orange focus:outline-none text-sm text-white leading-relaxed"&gt;&lt;/textarea&gt;
                        &lt;/div&gt;

                        &lt;div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-1"&gt;
                            &lt;div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-cnn-textMuted"&gt;
                                &lt;svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="clock" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-clock w-4 h-4 text-cnn-orange shrink-0"&gt;&lt;circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"&gt;&lt;/circle&gt;&lt;path d="M12 6v6l4 2"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;
                                &lt;span&gt;Вы можете выбрать &lt;b&gt;дату в календаре&lt;/b&gt; или &lt;b&gt;дни и часы&lt;/b&gt; — счетчик сам посчитает дни до окончания.&lt;/span&gt;
                            &lt;/div&gt;

                            &lt;button type="submit" class="py-2.5 px-6 rounded-xl bg-cnn-orange hover:bg-cnn-orangeHover text-white font-bold text-sm transition-all shadow-orange-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shrink-0"&gt;
                                &lt;svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="plus-circle" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-plus-circle w-4 h-4"&gt;&lt;circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"&gt;&lt;/circle&gt;&lt;path d="M8 12h8"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M12 8v8"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;
                                &lt;span&gt;Добавить в список&lt;/span&gt;
                            &lt;/button&gt;
                        &lt;/div&gt;
                    &lt;/form&gt;
                &lt;/div&gt;

                &lt;!-- Search &amp; Status Filter Bar + Right-aligned Legend --&gt;
                &lt;div class="flex flex-col xl:flex-row items-stretch xl:items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-cnn-card p-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-cnn-border"&gt;
                    &lt;div class="relative flex-1"&gt;
                        &lt;svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="search" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-search w-4 h-4 text-cnn-textMuted absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2"&gt;&lt;path d="m21 21-4.34-4.34"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"&gt;&lt;/circle&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;
                        &lt;input id="contractSearchInput" type="text" oninput="renderContracts()" placeholder="Поиск по кодовому слову, контрагенту или тексту..." class="w-full pl-10 pr-9 py-2 rounded-xl bg-cnn-bg border border-cnn-border focus:border-cnn-orange focus:outline-none text-sm text-white placeholder:text-cnn-textMuted transition-colors"&gt;
                        &lt;button id="clearSearchBtn" onclick="clearContractSearch()" class="hidden absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-cnn-textMuted hover:text-white"&gt;
                            &lt;svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="x" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-x w-4 h-4"&gt;&lt;path d="M18 6 6 18"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="m6 6 12 12"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;
                        &lt;/button&gt;
                    &lt;/div&gt;

                    &lt;div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between xl:justify-end gap-2.5 shrink-0"&gt;
                        &lt;!-- Filter by Expiration Status ("Активен" / "Скоро истекает") --&gt;
                        &lt;div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-cnn-bg p-1 rounded-xl border border-cnn-border"&gt;
                            &lt;button onclick="setContractFilter('all')" id="filterBtnAll" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all bg-cnn-orange text-white"&gt;
                                Все контракты
                            &lt;/button&gt;
                            &lt;button onclick="setContractFilter('active')" id="filterBtnActive" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all text-cnn-textMuted hover:text-white flex items-center gap-1.5"&gt;
                                &lt;span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
                                &lt;span&gt;Активен (≥ 2 дн.)&lt;/span&gt;
                            &lt;/button&gt;
                            &lt;button onclick="setContractFilter('expiring')" id="filterBtnExpiring" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all text-cnn-textMuted hover:text-white flex items-center gap-1.5"&gt;
                                &lt;span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
                                &lt;span&gt;Скоро истекает (&amp;lt; 2 дн.)&lt;/span&gt;
                            &lt;/button&gt;
                        &lt;/div&gt;

                        &lt;!-- Right-side Auto-delete Rule Badge --&gt;
                        &lt;div class="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-cnn-bg border border-cnn-border text-[11px] text-cnn-textMuted ml-auto xl:ml-0"&gt;
                            &lt;svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="trash-2" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-trash-2 w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cnn-orange shrink-0"&gt;&lt;path d="M10 11v6"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M14 11v6"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M19 6v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M3 6h18"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M8 6V4a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;
                            &lt;span&gt;При &lt;b class="text-white font-mono"&gt;0 ч.&lt;/b&gt; контракт удаляется автоматически&lt;/span&gt;
                        &lt;/div&gt;
                    &lt;/div&gt;
                &lt;/div&gt;

                &lt;!-- Contracts Vertical List Header Labels (Desktop) --&gt;
                &lt;div class="hidden md:flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-2 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-cnn-textMuted"&gt;
                    &lt;div class="flex items-center gap-4"&gt;
                        &lt;span&gt;Статус / Осталось времени / Кодовое слово&lt;/span&gt;
                        &lt;span class="text-cnn-orange"&gt;•&lt;/span&gt;
                        &lt;span&gt;Спойлер (текст)&lt;/span&gt;
                    &lt;/div&gt;
                    &lt;div class="text-right"&gt;С кем заключен контракт&lt;/div&gt;
                &lt;/div&gt;

                &lt;!-- Contracts Vertical List Container --&gt;
                &lt;div id="contractsListContainer" class="flex flex-col space-y-3"&gt;
                    &lt;div class="contract-row bg-cnn-card border border-cnn-orange/50 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden"&gt;
                        &lt;div class="p-3.5 sm:px-5 flex flex-wrap sm:flex-nowrap items-center justify-between gap-3 w-full"&gt;
                            
                            &lt;div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"&gt;
                                &lt;span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold bg-cnn-orangeMuted text-cnn-orange border border-cnn-orange/40" title="Закрепленный контракт"&gt;

                                        &lt;svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" data-lucide="sparkles" aria-hidden="true" class="lucide lucide-sparkles w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cnn-orange"&gt;&lt;path d="M11.017 2.814a1 1 0 0 1 1.966 0l1.051 5.558a2 2 0 0 0 1.594 1.594l5.558 1.051a1 1 0 0 1 0 1.966l-5.558 1.051a2 2 0 0 0-1.594 1.594l-1.051 5.558a1 1 0 0 1-1.966 0l-1.051-5.558a2 2 0 0 0-1.594-1.594l-5.558-1.051a1 1 0 0 1 0-1.966l5.558-1.051a2 2 0 0 0 1.594-1.594z"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M20 2v4"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;path d="M22 4h-4"&gt;&lt;/path&gt;&lt;circle cx="4" cy="20" r="2"&gt;&lt;/circle&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;

                                &lt;p class="text-xs text-cnn-textMuted mt-0.5"&gt;

                    &lt;p class="text-xs text-cnn-textMuted"&gt;Скопируйте примеры или правила из темы &lt;a href="https://forum.santamaria-rp.com/threads/%F0%9F%93%8B-%D0%9F%D0%A0%D0%90%D0%92%D0%98%D0%9B%D0%90-%D0%A0%D0%95%D0%94%D0%90%D0%9A%D0%A2%D0%98%D0%A0%D0%9E%D0%92%D0%90%D0%9D%D0%98%D0%AF-%D0%9E%D0%91%D0%AA%D0%AF%D0%92%D0%9B%D0%95%D0%9D%D0%98%D0%99-cnn.6500/" target="_blank" class="text-cnn-orange underline"&gt;ПРАВИЛА РЕДАКТИРОВАНИЯ ОБЪЯВЛЕНИЙ [CNN]&lt;/a&gt; и вставьте ниже&lt;/p&gt;

Продам а/с &amp;quot;Воздушный шар&amp;quot; с гравировкой +12. Цена: Договорная.

                &lt;pre id="splitFileCodePreview" class="flex-1 overflow-auto font-mono text-xs text-gray-200 leading-relaxed select-all"&gt;body {
            background-color: #121214;
            color: #f4f4f6;
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: #121214;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #26262e;
            border-radius: 4px;
            border: 1px solid #32323d;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: #ff6b00;
        }

        .codeword-btn:active {
            transform: scale(0.96);
        }

        .contract-row {
            transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease;
        }
        .contract-row:hover {
            border-color: rgba(255, 107, 0, 0.5);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(255, 107, 0, 0.2);
        }

        .glass-header {
            background: rgba(28, 28, 33, 0.9);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
        }

        @keyframes pulse-amber {
            0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35); }
            50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0); }
        }
        .expiring-badge {
            animation: pulse-amber 2s infinite;
        }&lt;/pre&gt;
